label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: param from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to response.sendRedirect(param) at line 21. Resolved sink value is user-controlled input. Although guarded by internal IP check (10.x.x.x), the redirect still accepts unsanitized user input which enables open redirect attacks. Path injection vulnerability confirmed.

evidence.note: User input param flows directly to sendRedirect sink without sanitization
